description: When: an agent ran and you have what it did. Gives: trajectory (trace + assertions: order, must_call, must_not_call, max/min calls, no_error, recovery, no_injection in tool results, no_pii in the final answer; OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain or ReAct traces) and tool calls (calls + tools: the arguments of each function call or tool_use, even a single one, checked against its declared definition in OpenAI, MCP or Anthropic form: name allowed, required arguments, types, enums, no extra argument). One gate per check, the worst on top; an unreadable trace is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS. Deterministic, no model call. Does not prove: that the agent reached the right outcome for the user, nor anything about calls absent from what you pass.

calls.description: Tool calls the agent made: {name, arguments} (or Anthropic {name, input}).

tools.description: The tool definitions it was given (OpenAI parameters, MCP inputSchema or Anthropic input_schema).

trace.description: Messages array, run tree, or a Thought/Action/Observation log.

name: evaluate_agent_run
